events.title: Demo Update: Japanese & Chinese Typing Fixes and Clearer Fonts
events.summary: This demo update focuses on playing Void Inc in your language: typing the weekly report, reading office messages, and finding your way around translated screens. Japanese and Chinese weekly reports Improved handling of text committed through an IME, including Japanese conversion. Enter can confirm a conversion and you can keep typing. events.title: Demo Update: Clearer Loading and Smoother CEO Briefings
events.summary: This update makes it easier to see what the game is doing while it starts. We've also worked on the pause when the CEO briefing begins, along with a few fixes for menus and notifications. Clearer loadingLoading messages and a progress bar now appear much earlier during startup, with translated messages in each supported language.The loading screen stays visible until the menu is ready. Smoother CEO briefingsReduced the hitch when a CEO briefing starts and the camera moves towards the wall screen

events.title: Demo Update: Fixes, Clearer CEO Calls & Optimisations
events.summary: Thank you to everyone playing and reporting issues! I've put some automatically crash/logging in to the game that I can react to a lot quicker, as well as the fixes below from the reports I've received so far: CEO calls and dialogue Fixed CEO broadcast subtitles reserving an oversized text box, which could push dialogue off screen. events.title: Demo Update: Fixes & Polish
events.summary: A small update to make your workday run more smoothly: Fixed save issues that could block starting a personal task after older company history was cleared. Fixed staff movement and coffee breaks falling behind when fast-forwarding the workday. Improved report navigation, staff level-up feedback, and planner layout. events.title: Patch Notes
events.summary: Unfortunately, the latest build was not really what we (and our players!) thought Void Inc should be and the release had a lot of issues and pain points. Thanks for your patience, I'm always looking to improve!Most of these are built around a smoother first day, clearer feedback, and a little more atmosphere around the office.Here's the changes we've completed today:Expanded opening experience: Explore an updated lobby and hallway with new environmental details and a few things to discover.Easie
